Footpad drag test on RC2 soil (Red Crushed Volcanic Scoria (Broadly graded)) at relative density 0; apparatus: subscale drag test equipment (SSD); loading: constant penetration drag: depth d 1 to 3 inch (table) held by locking the piston to the air cylinder; carriage accelerated by rubber bungee cords, then pulled at constant V_H by cam rod and friction drive wheel, then decelerated by springs and damper. Recorded: horizontal velocity V_H; drag load F_D; vertical load F_V; footpad pitch angle alpha; bed g_p from dynamic penetrometer with D_r and gamma; derived F_D/(d gamma A_ft), V_H/sqrt(dg), F_D/A_ft, F_V/A_pt as printed; one midpoint reading per run.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The measurements of this test have not been digitized yet; the setup and the source pages are indexed. The setup below rests on two agent readings of the report that were reconciled; no person has checked it yet. The test setup is incomplete: fill depth is not reported.
:::
